translations.web: Now therefore, Yahweh our God, save us from his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that you are Yahweh, even you only.”
translations.bsb: And now, O LORD our God, save us from his hand, so that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that You alone, O LORD, are God.”
translations.kjv: Now therefore, O LORD our God, save us from his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that thou art the LORD,
translations.asv: Now therefore, O Jehovah our God, save us from his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that thou art Jehovah, even thou only.
